name: Jerónimos Monastery
lead_time: Book a few days ahead
description: A riverside monastery carved in the ornate Manueline style, with one of Europe's most beautiful cloisters.
tips: Visits are timed: book a date and time.
Open 9:30 to 17:30, last entry 17:00. Closed Mondays.
Pair it with the Belém Tower and warm pastéis de nata nearby.

audio.script: Jerónimos Monastery was begun in the early fifteen hundreds, paid for by the spice trade that followed the sea voyages to India. Look for the rope, coral and sea creatures carved into the stone. That style is called Manueline, after King Manuel the First. The explorer Vasco da Gama is buried in the church.

scripts.es: El Monasterio de los Jerónimos se empezó a construir a principios del siglo dieciséis, pagado con el comercio de especias que siguió a los viajes por mar a la India. Busca las cuerdas, los corales y las criaturas marinas talladas en la piedra. Ese estilo se llama manuelino, por el rey Manuel primero. El explorador Vasco da Gama está enterrado en la iglesia.
scripts.fr: Le monastère des Hiéronymites a été commencé au début du seizième siècle, financé par le commerce des épices né des voyages maritimes vers l’Inde. Cherchez les cordages, les coraux et les créatures marines sculptés dans la pierre. Ce style s’appelle manuélin, d’après le roi Manuel premier. L’explorateur Vasco de Gama repose dans l’église.
scripts.pt: O Mosteiro dos Jerónimos começou a ser construído no início do século dezesseis, pago pelo comércio de especiarias que veio depois das viagens marítimas à Índia. Repare nas cordas, nos corais e nas criaturas marinhas esculpidas na pedra. Esse estilo se chama manuelino, por causa do rei Manuel primeiro. O navegador Vasco da Gama está sepultado na igreja.
scripts.de: Mit dem Bau des Hieronymitenklosters wurde Anfang des sechzehnten Jahrhunderts begonnen, bezahlt mit dem Gewürzhandel, der auf die Seereisen nach Indien folgte. Achten Sie auf die Taue, Korallen und Meerestiere, die in den Stein gemeißelt sind. Dieser Stil heißt Manuelinik, nach König Manuel dem Ersten. Der Entdecker Vasco da Gama liegt in der Kirche begraben.
scripts.it: Il Monastero dei Jerónimos fu iniziato all’inizio del Cinquecento, pagato con il commercio delle spezie seguito ai viaggi per mare verso l’India. Cerca le corde, i coralli e le creature marine scolpite nella pietra. Questo stile si chiama manuelino, dal re Manuele primo. L’esploratore Vasco da Gama è sepolto nella chiesa.

name: Belém Tower
lead_time: Book a few days ahead
description: The little fortress on the Tagus that once guarded the way into Lisboa. Freshly restored.
tips: Reopened in May 2026 after a year of restoration, with timed slots and about 900 visitors a day.
Open 9:30 to 17:30, last entry 17:00. Closed Mondays.
In person, tickets are sold at the Jerónimos ticket office.

audio.script: The Belém Tower was built in the early fifteen hundreds to defend the mouth of the river Tagus. Ships setting out on voyages of discovery passed right here. Look for the carved rhinoceros head on the outside wall, inspired by a real rhino sent to Lisboa as a royal gift.

scripts.es: La Torre de Belém se construyó a principios del siglo dieciséis para defender la desembocadura del río Tajo. Los barcos que partían a los viajes de descubrimiento pasaban justo por aquí. Busca la cabeza de rinoceronte tallada en el muro exterior, inspirada en un rinoceronte de verdad enviado a Lisboa como regalo real.
scripts.fr: La tour de Belém a été construite au début du seizième siècle pour défendre l’embouchure du Tage. Les navires partant pour les grandes découvertes passaient juste ici. Cherchez la tête de rhinocéros sculptée sur le mur extérieur, inspirée d’un vrai rhinocéros envoyé à Lisboa comme cadeau royal.
scripts.pt: A Torre de Belém foi construída no início do século dezesseis para defender a foz do rio Tejo. Os navios que partiam para as viagens dos descobrimentos passavam bem aqui. Procure a cabeça de rinoceronte esculpida na parede externa, inspirada num rinoceronte de verdade enviado a Lisboa como presente real.
scripts.de: Der Turm von Belém wurde Anfang des sechzehnten Jahrhunderts gebaut, um die Mündung des Tejo zu verteidigen. Die Schiffe, die zu den Entdeckungsfahrten aufbrachen, fuhren genau hier vorbei. Suchen Sie den in die Außenmauer gemeißelten Nashornkopf. Vorbild war ein echtes Nashorn, das als königliches Geschenk nach Lisboa kam.
scripts.it: La Torre di Belém fu costruita all’inizio del Cinquecento per difendere la foce del fiume Tago. Le navi in partenza per i viaggi di scoperta passavano proprio da qui. Cerca la testa di rinoceronte scolpita sul muro esterno, ispirata a un vero rinoceronte mandato a Lisboa come dono reale.

name: Pastéis de Belém
description: The famous custard tart bakery, baking since 1837. Eat them warm with cinnamon.
tips: The takeaway line moves quickly; the tiled rooms inside are bigger than they look.

name: MAAT museum
description: Art, architecture and technology in a wave-shaped building on the river.
tips: Walk up over the curved roof for river views.
Open noon to 7pm, closed Tuesdays (Time Out Lisbon, checked Oct 11 2026).

name: São Jorge Castle
description: Castle walls on one of Lisboa's highest hills, with views over the river and red rooftops.
tips: Late afternoon light over the river is the best time.
Buying online skips the ticket line.

audio.script: São Jorge Castle sits on one of the hills where Lisboa began. Its walls date mostly from the Moorish period and the centuries after, when Portugal's kings lived here. From the ramparts you can see the river Tagus, the Baixa grid rebuilt after the 1755 earthquake, and the bridge to the south bank.

scripts.es: El Castillo de San Jorge se alza sobre una de las colinas donde nació Lisboa. Sus murallas son en su mayoría de la época morisca y de los siglos siguientes, cuando aquí vivían los reyes de Portugal. Desde las almenas se ven el río Tajo, la cuadrícula de la Baixa reconstruida tras el terremoto de 1755 y el puente hacia la orilla sur.
scripts.fr: Le château Saint-Georges domine l’une des collines où Lisboa est née. Ses murailles datent surtout de l’époque maure et des siècles suivants, quand les rois du Portugal vivaient ici. Depuis les remparts, on voit le Tage, le quadrillage de la Baixa reconstruit après le tremblement de terre de 1755 et le pont vers la rive sud.
scripts.pt: O Castelo de São Jorge fica numa das colinas onde Lisboa começou. Suas muralhas são, na maior parte, do período mouro e dos séculos seguintes, quando os reis de Portugal moravam aqui. Das muralhas dá para ver o rio Tejo, o traçado da Baixa reconstruído depois do terremoto de 1755 e a ponte para a margem sul.
scripts.de: Die Burg São Jorge steht auf einem der Hügel, auf denen Lisboa entstand. Ihre Mauern stammen größtenteils aus maurischer Zeit und den folgenden Jahrhunderten, als hier Portugals Könige lebten. Von den Wehrgängen sehen Sie den Tejo, das Straßenraster der Baixa, das nach dem Erdbeben von 1755 neu gebaut wurde, und die Brücke zum Südufer.
scripts.it: Il Castello di São Jorge sorge su uno dei colli dove nacque Lisboa. Le mura risalgono per lo più al periodo moresco e ai secoli successivi, quando qui vivevano i re del Portogallo. Dai bastioni si vedono il Tago, la griglia della Baixa ricostruita dopo il terremoto del 1755 e il ponte verso la riva sud.

name: Alfama lanes
description: Lisboa's oldest neighborhood: stairways, laundry lines, tiny squares and fado drifting from doorways.
tips: Get a little lost; the lanes always lead down to the river.
Evenings are for fado. Book a fado house for dinner.

audio.script: Alfama is Lisboa's oldest district. Much of it survived the great earthquake of 1755, so the street plan is still a tangle of stairways and alleys. Listen in the evenings: this is the home of fado, songs of longing sung to the Portuguese guitar.

scripts.es: Alfama es el barrio más antiguo de Lisboa. Gran parte sobrevivió al gran terremoto de 1755, así que sus calles siguen siendo un laberinto de escaleras y callejones. Escucha por la noche: aquí nació el fado, canciones de añoranza acompañadas por la guitarra portuguesa.
scripts.fr: L’Alfama est le plus vieux quartier de Lisboa. Une grande partie a survécu au grand tremblement de terre de 1755, si bien que ses rues restent un enchevêtrement d’escaliers et de ruelles. Tendez l’oreille le soir : c’est le berceau du fado, des chants de nostalgie accompagnés par la guitare portugaise.
scripts.pt: Alfama é o bairro mais antigo de Lisboa. Boa parte dele sobreviveu ao grande terremoto de 1755, por isso as ruas ainda são um emaranhado de escadarias e becos. Preste atenção à noite: aqui é a casa do fado, canções de saudade cantadas ao som da guitarra portuguesa.
scripts.de: Die Alfama ist Lisboas ältestes Viertel. Vieles hat das große Erdbeben von 1755 überstanden, deshalb ist der Grundriss bis heute ein Gewirr aus Treppen und Gassen. Hören Sie abends hin: Hier ist der Fado zu Hause, Lieder der Sehnsucht, begleitet von der portugiesischen Gitarre.
scripts.it: L’Alfama è il quartiere più antico di Lisboa. Gran parte sopravvisse al grande terremoto del 1755, così le strade sono ancora un intrico di scalinate e vicoli. Ascolta la sera: qui è nato il fado, canti di nostalgia accompagnati dalla chitarra portoghese.

name: Santa Luzia viewpoint
description: A tiled terrace with bougainvillea and views over Alfama's rooftops to the river.

name: Senhora do Monte viewpoint
description: One of the highest viewpoints in the city. Beautiful at sunset, quieter than the famous ones.

name: Feira da Ladra flea market
description: Lisboa's flea market for tiles, vintage finds and odds and ends. Tuesdays and Saturdays.
tips: Go in the morning. Check tiles carefully and bargain politely.
Many sellers pack up by about 2pm.

name: Tram 28
area: Martim Moniz to Campo de Ourique
description: The vintage yellow tram that rattles up and down the hills through Graça, Alfama, Baixa and Estrela.
tips: Ride early in the morning to get a seat.
It is crowded and known for pickpockets: keep your bag in front.

name: Praça do Comércio
description: The grand riverside square, rebuilt after the 1755 earthquake, with a triumphal arch into the Baixa.

name: Santa Justa Lift
description: A 1902 iron elevator linking the Baixa with the Carmo ruins above.
tips: Lines get long. You can also walk up and reach the top viewing platform from Carmo.

name: Livraria Bertrand
description: Said to be the world's oldest bookshop still trading, open since 1732. Lovely for gifts.

name: São Pedro de Alcântara viewpoint
description: A garden terrace looking across to the castle. Easy to reach on the Glória funicular.

name: Príncipe Real shops and garden
description: Concept stores, Portuguese design and a shady garden square. One of the nicest areas for shopping.

name: Time Out Market
description: A big food hall with stalls from well-known Lisboa chefs and bakeries, next to the old produce market.
tips: Busy at lunch and dinner. Mid-afternoon is calmer.

name: LX Factory
description: A converted factory complex full of design shops, cafés, street art and the Ler Devagar bookshop.
tips: Weekend afternoons are liveliest. Combine with Belém on the same day.

name: Gulbenkian Museum and garden
description: A remarkable private art collection in calm modern galleries, set in a lovely garden.
tips: Museum open 10:00 to 18:00, closed Tuesdays (gulbenkian.pt, checked Oct 11 2026). The garden is a calm place to rest.

name: Oceanário de Lisboa
description: One of Europe's great aquariums, built around a huge central ocean tank.
tips: Open daily 10:00 to 20:00, last entry 19:00.
Online tickets let you skip the ticket line.

name: National Tile Museum
description: Five centuries of Portuguese tiles in a former convent, including a long panorama of Lisboa before the earthquake.
tips: Renovation works were under way in 2026. Check that it is open before you go.

name: Pena Palace

price.source: Parques de Sintra, opening times and prices page

lead_time: Book a few days ahead
description: The candy-colored hilltop palace in Sintra's forests. The most famous day out from Lisboa.
tips: Online tickets need a date reservation.
Palace 9:30 to 18:30, park 9:00 to 19:00.
Go early: the hill road and shuttles get very busy.

audio.script: Pena Palace was built in the eighteen hundreds for King Ferdinand the Second, on the ruins of a monastery. He mixed Gothic, Moorish and Manueline styles, then painted it yellow and red. On a clear day you can see from the terraces all the way to the Atlantic.

scripts.es: El Palacio da Pena se construyó en el siglo diecinueve para el rey Fernando segundo, sobre las ruinas de un monasterio. Mezcló los estilos gótico, morisco y manuelino, y luego lo pintó de amarillo y rojo. En un día despejado, desde las terrazas se ve hasta el Atlántico.
scripts.fr: Le palais de Pena a été construit au dix-neuvième siècle pour le roi Ferdinand deux, sur les ruines d’un monastère. Il a mêlé les styles gothique, mauresque et manuélin, puis l’a peint en jaune et en rouge. Par temps clair, on voit depuis les terrasses jusqu’à l’Atlantique.
scripts.pt: O Palácio da Pena foi construído no século dezenove para o rei Fernando segundo, sobre as ruínas de um mosteiro. Ele misturou os estilos gótico, mourisco e manuelino e depois pintou tudo de amarelo e vermelho. Num dia claro, dá para ver das varandas até o Atlântico.
scripts.de: Der Pena-Palast wurde im neunzehnten Jahrhundert für König Ferdinand den Zweiten auf den Ruinen eines Klosters gebaut. Er mischte Gotik, maurischen Stil und Manuelinik und ließ alles gelb und rot streichen. An klaren Tagen sieht man von den Terrassen bis zum Atlantik.
scripts.it: Il Palazzo da Pena fu costruito nell’Ottocento per il re Ferdinando secondo, sulle rovine di un monastero. Mescolò gli stili gotico, moresco e manuelino, poi lo dipinse di giallo e di rosso. Nelle giornate limpide, dalle terrazze si vede fino all’Atlantico.

name: Quinta da Regaleira
description: A mysterious estate of grottoes, towers and a spiral well that winds deep into the ground.
tips: Go early or late; the Initiation Well gets lines by late morning.
Wear shoes with grip for the tunnels and steps.

audio.script: Quinta da Regaleira was created in the early nineteen hundreds by a wealthy collector and an Italian architect. The famous Initiation Well is not for water: it is a spiral staircase nine floors deep, full of symbols. Tunnels at the bottom lead out into the garden.

scripts.es: La Quinta da Regaleira se creó a principios del siglo veinte por un rico coleccionista y un arquitecto italiano. El famoso Pozo Iniciático no es para el agua: es una escalera de caracol de nueve pisos de profundidad, llena de símbolos. Los túneles del fondo salen al jardín.
scripts.fr: La Quinta da Regaleira a été créée au début du vingtième siècle par un riche collectionneur et un architecte italien. Le célèbre puits initiatique n’a jamais servi à l’eau : c’est un escalier en spirale profond de neuf étages, couvert de symboles. Des tunnels au fond ressortent dans le jardin.
scripts.pt: A Quinta da Regaleira foi criada no início do século vinte por um colecionador rico e um arquiteto italiano. O famoso Poço Iniciático não é para água: é uma escada em espiral com nove andares de profundidade, cheia de símbolos. Túneis lá embaixo levam para o jardim.
scripts.de: Die Quinta da Regaleira entstand Anfang des zwanzigsten Jahrhunderts, geschaffen von einem reichen Sammler und einem italienischen Architekten. Der berühmte Initiationsbrunnen war nie für Wasser gedacht: Er ist eine neun Stockwerke tiefe Wendeltreppe voller Symbole. Tunnel am Grund führen hinaus in den Garten.
scripts.it: La Quinta da Regaleira fu creata all’inizio del Novecento da un ricco collezionista e da un architetto italiano. Il famoso Pozzo Iniziatico non è per l’acqua: è una scala a chiocciola profonda nove piani, piena di simboli. In fondo, alcuni tunnel sbucano nel giardino.

name: Moorish Castle

price.source: Parques de Sintra, opening times and prices page

description: Stone walls snaking along the ridge above Sintra, with views to Pena Palace.

name: Monserrate Palace

price.source: Parques de Sintra, opening times and prices page

description: An exotic, lacy palace with romantic gardens, much quieter than Pena.

name: Pastel de nata baking class
lead_time: Small groups: book a few days ahead.
description: Learn the flaky pastry and custard behind Lisboa's favorite tart, then eat your own, warm.
search_q: pastel de nata baking class Lisbon

name: Tile painting workshop
lead_time: Book a few days ahead. Some tiles need firing, so check pickup or shipping.
description: Paint your own azulejo in the traditional blue and white, with a local artist. A lovely souvenir.

name: Fado dinner in Alfama
lead_time: The small, good houses fill up. Book ahead for Friday and Saturday.
description: Dinner while fado singers perform Portugal's soulful songs. Silence is expected while they sing.

name: Food and wine walking tour
lead_time: Book a few days ahead.
description: Petiscos, cheese, tinned fish, ginjinha and wine with a local guide. A great first-day orientation.
search_q: food and wine walking tour Lisbon

name: Sunset sail on the Tagus
lead_time: Book a day or two ahead; trips depend on the weather.
description: A small sailboat past Belém and under the bridge as the city turns gold. Often with a glass of wine.

name: Portuguese wine tasting
lead_time: Booking recommended.
description: Taste wines from the Douro, Alentejo and beyond, plus port, in a cozy wine bar or cellar.

name: Sintra
lead_time: Book Pena Palace before you go. A guided tour or private driver avoids the uphill shuttle lines.
description: Fairy-tale palaces and gardens in misty green hills. Pena needs a dated ticket; the rest are flexible.
tips: Go on a weekday and arrive early. Crowds build fast by late morning.
With a driver, ask to be dropped at the palace gates rather than trying to park.
Pena tickets are for a set time, so plan the rest of the day around it.
Wear shoes with grip: steep paths, steps and tunnels.
how: Train from Rossio station, then the local bus or a taxi up to the palaces

name: Cascais and Cabo da Roca
lead_time: No booking needed for the train.
description: A seaside town with beaches and a pretty old center. Add Cabo da Roca, mainland Europe's westernmost point, by taxi or tour.
how: Train from Cais do Sodré along the coast

name: Arrábida and Setúbal wine
lead_time: Tours run in small groups; book a few days ahead.
description: Turquoise coves under green hills, then a winery tasting of Moscatel de Setúbal.
search_q: Arrabida Setubal wine tour from Lisbon
how: Best by tour or private driver

name: Óbidos
lead_time: No booking needed if you go on your own.
description: A whitewashed walled village with flower-lined lanes. Try ginja, a cherry liqueur, in a little chocolate cup.

name: Ponta da Piedade
description: Golden cliffs, sea stacks and grottoes at the tip of Lagos. The Algarve's most famous view.
tips: Come at sunset, or see it from the water by boat or kayak.
Stay back from the cliff edges; they crumble.

audio.script: Ponta da Piedade is a headland of soft golden limestone. Wind and waves have carved it into arches, pillars and caves over thousands of years. The lighthouse marks the point. Below, small boats and kayaks slip between the rocks into the grottoes.

scripts.es: Ponta da Piedade es un cabo de piedra caliza dorada y blanda. El viento y las olas la han tallado en arcos, columnas y cuevas durante miles de años. El faro marca la punta. Abajo, barquitas y kayaks se cuelan entre las rocas hacia las grutas.
scripts.fr: La Ponta da Piedade est un promontoire de calcaire doré et tendre. Le vent et les vagues l’ont sculpté en arches, en piliers et en grottes pendant des milliers d’années. Le phare marque la pointe. En contrebas, petits bateaux et kayaks se glissent entre les rochers jusqu’aux grottes.
scripts.pt: A Ponta da Piedade é um promontório de calcário dourado e macio. O vento e as ondas o esculpiram em arcos, pilares e cavernas ao longo de milhares de anos. O farol marca a ponta. Lá embaixo, barquinhos e caiaques passam entre as rochas até as grutas.
scripts.de: Die Ponta da Piedade ist eine Landspitze aus weichem, goldenem Kalkstein. Wind und Wellen haben daraus über Jahrtausende Bögen, Säulen und Höhlen geformt. Der Leuchtturm markiert die Spitze. Unten gleiten kleine Boote und Kajaks zwischen den Felsen in die Grotten.
scripts.it: Ponta da Piedade è un promontorio di calcare dorato e tenero. Vento e onde l’hanno scolpito in archi, pilastri e grotte nel corso di migliaia di anni. Il faro segna la punta. Sotto, barchette e kayak scivolano tra le rocce fino alle grotte.

name: Praia Dona Ana
description: A sheltered cove of golden sand framed by rock stacks, an easy walk from Lagos.

name: Praia do Camilo
description: A tiny, photogenic cove reached by a long wooden staircase down the cliff.

name: Lagos old town
description: Cobbled lanes inside old town walls, with cafés, boutiques and seafood restaurants.

name: Cape St Vincent
description: The dramatic southwestern tip of mainland Europe, with a lighthouse on sheer cliffs. Famous for sunset.
tips: It is windy and cool at sunset; bring a layer.
Sagres Fortress is nearby.

audio.script: Cape Saint Vincent is the southwestern corner of mainland Europe. For centuries sailors saw it as the edge of the known world. The lighthouse here is one of the most powerful in Europe, guiding ships around the corner between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean routes.

scripts.es: El Cabo de San Vicente es la esquina suroeste de la Europa continental. Durante siglos, los marineros lo vieron como el fin del mundo conocido. Su faro es uno de los más potentes de Europa y guía a los barcos en la curva entre las rutas del Atlántico y del Mediterráneo.
scripts.fr: Le cap Saint-Vincent est l’angle sud-ouest de l’Europe continentale. Pendant des siècles, les marins y ont vu la limite du monde connu. Son phare est l’un des plus puissants d’Europe et guide les navires dans le virage entre les routes de l’Atlantique et de la Méditerranée.
scripts.pt: O Cabo de São Vicente é o canto sudoeste da Europa continental. Durante séculos, os marinheiros o viram como o fim do mundo conhecido. O farol daqui é um dos mais potentes da Europa e guia os navios na curva entre as rotas do Atlântico e do Mediterrâneo.
scripts.de: Das Kap São Vicente ist die Südwestecke des europäischen Festlands. Jahrhundertelang hielten Seeleute es für das Ende der bekannten Welt. Sein Leuchtturm gehört zu den stärksten Europas und lotst die Schiffe um die Ecke zwischen den Routen von Atlantik und Mittelmeer.
scripts.it: Capo San Vincenzo è l’angolo sud-occidentale dell’Europa continentale. Per secoli i marinai lo considerarono il confine del mondo conosciuto. Il suo faro è uno dei più potenti d’Europa e guida le navi attorno alla curva tra le rotte dell’Atlantico e del Mediterraneo.

name: Sagres Fortress
description: A walled headland above the Atlantic, linked to Portugal's age of exploration.
tips: Check opening hours locally before you go.

name: Benagil sea cave
lead_time: In October, a day or two ahead is usually enough. Trips depend on the sea.
description: A cathedral-like sea cave with a round hole in its roof that lets in a column of light.
tips: Visit by guided boat or guided kayak only.
Landing on the beach inside the cave and swimming in are not allowed.
Boat numbers inside are limited, so trips run in short turns.

audio.script: The Benagil cave was hollowed out of the soft limestone by the sea. Its domed ceiling has a round opening, the eye, that lets daylight pour onto the small beach inside. To protect it, visitors now enter only by guided boat or kayak, and no one may land on the beach.

scripts.es: El mar excavó la cueva de Benagil en la piedra caliza blanda. Su techo en forma de cúpula tiene una abertura redonda, el ojo, por donde entra la luz del día hasta la pequeña playa interior. Para protegerla, ahora solo se entra en barco o kayak con guía, y nadie puede desembarcar en la playa.
scripts.fr: La mer a creusé la grotte de Benagil dans le calcaire tendre. Sa voûte en coupole est percée d’une ouverture ronde, l’œil, qui laisse entrer la lumière du jour sur la petite plage intérieure. Pour la protéger, on n’y entre plus qu’en bateau ou en kayak guidé, et personne ne peut débarquer sur la plage.
scripts.pt: A gruta de Benagil foi escavada pelo mar no calcário macio. O teto em forma de cúpula tem uma abertura redonda, o olho, que deixa a luz do dia entrar na pequena praia lá dentro. Para protegê-la, agora só se entra de barco ou caiaque com guia, e ninguém pode desembarcar na praia.
scripts.de: Das Meer hat die Höhle von Benagil aus dem weichen Kalkstein gewaschen. Ihre Kuppel hat eine runde Öffnung, das Auge, durch das Tageslicht auf den kleinen Strand im Inneren fällt. Zum Schutz darf man heute nur noch mit geführtem Boot oder Kajak hinein, und niemand darf am Strand anlegen.
scripts.it: La grotta di Benagil è stata scavata dal mare nel calcare tenero. La volta a cupola ha un’apertura rotonda, l’occhio, che lascia entrare la luce del giorno sulla piccola spiaggia interna. Per proteggerla, oggi si entra solo in barca o in kayak con guida, e nessuno può sbarcare sulla spiaggia.

name: Praia da Marinha
description: Often called one of Europe's most beautiful beaches: clear water under honey-colored cliffs.
tips: Steps lead down from the clifftop car park.
It is the start of the Seven Hanging Valleys trail.

name: Seven Hanging Valleys trail
area: Praia da Marinha to Vale Centeanes
description: A clifftop walk past Benagil and dramatic coves, one of the best coastal walks in Portugal.
tips: About 6 km one way (estimate). Most people walk one way and take a taxi back.
Little shade: bring water and a hat.
Stay on the marked path and back from the edges.

name: Algar Seco
description: Wind-carved rock formations and natural windows over the sea, by a boardwalk from Carvoeiro.

name: Praia da Falésia
description: Kilometers of beach under red, ochre and white cliffs. Wonderful for long walks.

name: Albufeira old town
description: Whitewashed streets above Fishermen's Beach, busy with restaurants and night life.

name: Faro old town
description: A calm walled quarter of cobbled squares and a cathedral, with storks nesting on the rooftops.

name: Chapel of Bones, Faro
description: A small chapel behind the Carmo church lined with the bones of monks. Haunting, and brief.

name: Ria Formosa lagoon
description: A protected lagoon of salt marshes, flamingos and sandy barrier islands, reached by boat.
tips: Boat trips and island ferries leave from Faro and Olhão.

name: Tavira
description: An elegant river town of churches, castle walls and an old bridge. The Algarve at its most graceful.

audio.script: Tavira sits on both banks of the river Gilão. Look up at the rooftops: many have four-sided hipped roofs, a local tradition. From the castle walls you can count the town's church towers and see across the salt marshes to the sea.

scripts.es: Tavira se extiende a ambas orillas del río Gilão. Mira los tejados: muchos son de cuatro aguas, una tradición local. Desde las murallas del castillo puedes contar los campanarios de la ciudad y ver, más allá de las salinas, el mar.
scripts.fr: Tavira s’étend sur les deux rives du Gilão. Levez les yeux vers les toits : beaucoup ont quatre pans, une tradition locale. Depuis les remparts du château, vous pouvez compter les clochers de la ville et voir la mer au-delà des marais salants.
scripts.pt: Tavira fica nas duas margens do rio Gilão. Olhe para os telhados: muitos têm quatro águas, uma tradição local. Das muralhas do castelo dá para contar as torres das igrejas da cidade e ver o mar além das salinas.
scripts.de: Tavira liegt an beiden Ufern des Flusses Gilão. Schauen Sie auf die Dächer: Viele sind vierseitige Walmdächer, eine örtliche Tradition. Von der Burgmauer aus können Sie die Kirchtürme der Stadt zählen und über die Salzwiesen bis zum Meer blicken.
scripts.it: Tavira si stende su entrambe le rive del fiume Gilão. Guarda i tetti: molti sono a quattro falde, una tradizione locale. Dalle mura del castello puoi contare i campanili della città e vedere il mare oltre le saline.

name: Ilha de Tavira
description: A long, wild island beach reached by a short ferry. Fine sand and calm water.
tips: Don’t miss the last boat back. In October it has been around 6pm to 6:30pm from the island to Quatro Águas (approximate). Ask at the island dock when you arrive.
Wind can cancel sailings; keep an eye on the sky and leave a little early.

name: Silves Castle
description: Red sandstone walls above orange groves, once the Moorish capital of the Algarve.

name: Loulé market
description: A domed market hall full of local produce, cheeses, honey and crafts.
tips: Go in the morning.

name: Fóia, Monchique
description: The Algarve's highest point, with views over the whole coast on a clear day.

name: Benagil caves boat trip
area: From Benagil, Portimão, Carvoeiro or Armação de Pêra
lead_time: In October, a day or two ahead is usually enough. Trips depend on the sea.
description: Glide along the cliffs into the Benagil cave and nearby grottoes. Guided boats and kayaks only.

name: Ponta da Piedade by kayak or boat
lead_time: Book a day or two ahead.
description: Paddle or float between the arches and grottoes of Lagos. Calm mornings are best.
search_q: Ponta da Piedade kayak tour Lagos

name: Ria Formosa islands boat trip
lead_time: Book a day or two ahead.
description: Birdlife, oyster beds and island beaches in the protected lagoon.
search_q: Ria Formosa islands boat trip Faro

name: Dolphin watching
lead_time: Book a day or two ahead.
description: Head out into open water to look for dolphins. Sightings are common but never guaranteed.

name: Algarve winery tasting
lead_time: Estates take limited visitors; book ahead.
description: Visit a vineyard estate in the hills and taste local whites, rosés and reds.

name: Cataplana cooking class
lead_time: Small groups; book a few days ahead.
description: Cook the Algarve's signature seafood stew in its clam-shaped copper pan, then share the meal.

name: Spa day
lead_time: Book treatments a few days ahead.
description: Many resort hotels open their spas to day guests: pools, steam rooms and massages after the cliffs.

name: Sunset catamaran cruise
lead_time: Book a day or two ahead.
description: Watch the cliffs glow at sunset from the water, often with a drink on board.

name: Sagres and Cape St Vincent
lead_time: No booking needed if you drive.
description: Wild surf beaches, a cliff fortress and sunset at the edge of Europe.
how: By car, private driver or tour from Lagos
stay: Half a day, ending at sunset

name: Tavira and its island
lead_time: No booking needed.
description: A slow day of churches and river cafés, then a short ferry to a long, quiet beach.
how: Regional train along the coast, or by car or driver

name: Silves and Monchique
lead_time: No booking needed if you drive.
description: A red castle town among orange groves, then cool green hills and the view from Fóia.
how: By car, private driver or tour

name: Sevilla, Spain
lead_time: Bring your passport. Spain is one hour ahead of Portugal.
description: The Alcázar, the cathedral and flamenco energy, over the border in Spain.
how: Organized tour or private driver; a long day
